opex.name: Selling & administrative
opex.note: Sales teams close to customers, application engineers, and the back office. Includes amortization of acquisition intangibles ($19M in the quarter).

footerNote: Nordson's fiscal year ends October 31, so this is its fiscal Q3; its fiscal Q4 (ending Oct 31, 2026) had not been reported yet. Figures are rounded to the nearest $M from the release, which reports in thousands. Nordson reports a single operating-expense line (selling and administrative).

kpis.label: EPS (GAAP)
kpis.note: a record, vs $2.22 a year ago

oneTimers: A $15M non-cash loss on minority investments (marked to fair value) sits inside 'other expense' this quarter. Nordson excludes it — and acquisition-related amortization and costs — from adjusted results: adjusted EPS was $3.25 versus $2.73 GAAP.
otherDetail: Interest expense, net, of $20M plus $17M of other expense, net — the latter mostly a $15M non-cash loss on minority investments — for a net $37M cost below operating profit.

segments.name: Industrial Precision Solutions
segments.note: Precision dispensing for packaging, coatings, polymer processing and nonwovens. Sales up 5% (organic +3%, plus currency and an acquisition contribution), at a 35% EBITDA margin.

segments.name: Medical and Fluid Solutions
segments.note: Fluid management components and medical products. An all-time record quarter; sales up 5%, or 11% organically once a divested contract-manufacturing business is excluded, at a 38% EBITDA margin.

segments.name: Advanced Technology Solutions
segments.note: Dispensing, test and inspection gear for electronics and semiconductors. Sales surged 28% (organic +31%) on strong demand for electronics dispense and test-and-inspection lines, at a 30% EBITDA margin.

takeaways.text: Sales hit an all-time quarterly record, up 10% (about 12% organically), with record quarters in all three segments. Advanced Technology Solutions led, up 28% on electronics demand.
takeaways.title: Record sales in every segment

takeaways.text: Gross margin widened to 55.5% and EBITDA reached a record $262M — 32 cents of every sales dollar before interest, tax and depreciation. That margin discipline is Nordson's signature.
takeaways.title: Best-in-class margins held

takeaways.text: Management raised full-year guidance to $3,035–3,075M of sales and $11.80–12.00 of adjusted EPS, pointing to backlog and order momentum — putting Nordson on track for its first $3B revenue year.
takeaways.title: Guidance raised

verdict: Record sales of $818M — up 10% with growth in all three segments — and Nordson raised its full-year guidance; a $15M paper loss on an investment only dented GAAP profit.
